result.journal: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET)
result.keywords: This article examines how ontology-driven models and blockchain infrastructure can be combined to support interoperable, privacy-aware e-learning services. It reviews use cases for secure credential exchange, learning analytics, and adaptive recommendation in digital education environments, while highlighting governance, scalability, and integration challenges. The discussion bridges decentralized record management with rule-based personalization to outline practical directions for next-generation educational platforms.
result.title: Semantic Interoperability and Privacy-Aware Analytics for Blockchain-Enabled Learning Systems
